snapshot_policy: Only the exact published Cargo package payloads are extracted under upstream/. Each payload includes Cargo's normalized and original manifests, VCS identity, lockfile, selected source/include files, and package licence/readme files. Unrelated workspace crates, bindings, generated native extensions, and sites are excluded.
release_gate: The extracted package payloads and checksums identify the published dag-ml and dag-ml-core 0.3.25 release exactly; Studio runtime resolution remains pinned to =0.3.25.
